notes: ACCESS: rejuvenation.com 403s every Chrome curl_cffi fingerprint but serves 200 to Safari/Firefox profiles; safari17_0 / safari18_0 / safari15_5 / firefox133 all worked (the probe.py rotation was pinned to those). Any query string on the origin is 403'd by the WAF, so listing pages were fetched as plain paths only. r.jina.ai returned its own Cloudflare 403 and www-rejuvenation-com.translate.goog returned a 403 from the origin, both retried this session - so no third-party render route exists. The host rate-limits after ~20 page fetches; requests were paced and the affected pages re-read. ROBOTS: https://www.rejuvenation.com/robots.txt fetched FIRST (200). Two named groups: 'User-agent: EasouSpider / Disallow: /' and 'User-agent: Pinterestbot / crawl-delay: 0.2'. There is NO group naming ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot or anthropic-ai anywhere in the file, so the generic 'User-agent: *' group applies. That group Allows /llms.txt and disallows /account/, /checkout/, /shoppingcart/, /services/, /shop_g/, /shop_r/, /products_g/, /products_r/, */minipip, */quicklook, /personalization/, */show-mobile-email-signup, */show-join-email.jsonp, */registry/list.json, */apartment-, /*N=, */order-shipment-tracking, */undefined and /shop/*+*+*. No Crawl-delay for *. Every URL I requested is a plain /shop/<dept>/<id>/ path with no query string, no 'N=' parameter and at most zero '+' segments, so nothing disallowed was fetched; the multi-facet URLs matching /shop/*+*+* were deliberately NOT requested. Sitemaps declared in robots.txt were used (netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-index.xml -> shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz, 802 URLs). TREE: taken from the site's OWN department side-nav, embedded in each department page's HTML as the JSON object "ssrSideNav" (id / type / name per node; type=header for grouping rows, type=subcat for real listings, type=category for collection folders, type=linkcat for cross-department links, plus a boolean "secret":true on nodes that are NOT rendered in the nav). ssrSideNav was pulled for /shop/bath/ (111 top-level nodes), /shop/mirrors/ and /shop/organization/. The rendered Bath tree is: [Bath Vanities & Sinks] All Vanities & Sinks | Shop Bath Vanity Collections (14 collection children) | (secret) Vanities; [Bath Plumbing] Bath Faucets, Shower Sets & Tub Faucets, Shower Heads & Arms, Supply Lines Drains & Levers, Shop Bath Plumbing Collections (13 children), All Bath Plumbing; [Bath Mirrors] Pivot Mirrors, Medicine Cabinets, All Bath Mirrors; [Bath Hardware] Toilet Paper Holders, Hooks & Racks, Towel Rings, Towel Bars & Warmers, Shower Hardware & Grab Bars, Shop Bath Hardware Collections (3), New Arrivals (4), Shop All (23), All Bath Hardware, (secret) Shower Grab Bars; [Bath Lighting] Ceiling Lighting, Wall Lighting, All Bath Lighting; [Bath Linens & Rugs] Bath Towels & Shower Curtains, Bath Mats & Rugs; [Bath Furniture & Accessories] Bath Furniture & Storage + a linkcat to Organization; [Bathtubs] All Bathtubs, (secret) All ADA & Accessible Bath; [New & Featured] and [Sale] (merchandising only); then ~60 further 'secret' brand-collection nodes. Cross-department bath nodes were checked too: /shop/mirrors/ has a 'Bath Mirrors' header whose three entries are linkcats pointing back at the SAME /shop/bath/pivot-mirrors, /shop/bath/medicine-cabinets and /shop/bath/bath-mirrors URLs (rule 28 - one record), and /shop/organization/ has a 'Laundry & Bath' header whose entries are linkcats back to Bath Furniture & Storage and the bath hooks/hardware nodes plus the mixed roll-up /shop/organization/all-laundry-bath-organization/. Every recorded URL is present verbatim in the site's own shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (89 /shop/bath/ URLs listed there). QTY: the listing pages are client-side SPAs - the SSR HTML carries "totalProductsCount":0 with no product tiles and no JSON-LD, and the grid is populated from Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com, constructorKey key_9BhS51IOFNhJejk4, declared in the page's own config alongside preconnect to https://ac.cnstrc.com). Every qty is response.total_num_results from https://ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<id>. PROOF THAT THIS IS THE RENDERED 'N Items' HEADER (this is the check the brief demanded): (1) the page config contains "productCountDisplay":{"displayText":"Items","isEnabled":true,...,"jumpLinkDisplayText":"View {{productCount}} Items"} - so the header literally reads '<N> Items'; (2) in the site's own bundle /.static/shop/202631/595053970/dist/shop.cd506c32.js the component computes productCount as `function(){return (this.$store.state.shop.cat.response.numFound)||0}` and productCountMessage builds the string from that productCount plus productCountDisplayConfig.displayText; (3) the Constructor adapter in the SAME bundle assigns `C.data.response.numFound = e.response.total_num_results` (and again `v.response.numFound = e.response.total_num_results` on the second code path). So rendered header N === Constructor response.total_num_results, by the site's own code. VERIFICATION: (a) group_id <-> URL mapping proven from the site side: each /shop/bath/<id>/ page's SSR payload carries "categoryId":"<id>" - e.g. /shop/bath/faucets/ carries "categoryId":"faucets" - and the same payload's breadcrumbData is Home > Bath > <node name>. All 13 leaf pages fetched in one pass returned HTTP 200 with breadcrumbs Home > Bath > Bathroom Faucets / Shower Sets & Tub Faucets / Shower Heads & Arms / Supply Lines, Drains, & Levers / Pivot Mirrors / Medicine Cabinets / Toilet Paper Holders / Towel Hooks & Bath Hooks / Towel Rings / Towel Bars & Towel Warmers / Shower Hardware & Grab Bars / Bath Furniture & Storage / Bathtubs - Clawfoot Tubs & Soaking Tubs. (b) FULL ENUMERATION: every one of those 13 groups was paged through Constructor at num_results_per_page=100 to the last short page and its unique product ids counted; unique-id count == total_num_results on all 13 with zero mismatches (faucets 103, shower-sets-tub-faucets 193, shower-heads-arms 23, supply-lines-drains-levers 68, pivot-mirrors 27, medicine-cabinets 15, toilet-paper-holders 27, bath-hooks 107, towel-rings 22, towel-bars-towel-warmers 47, shower-door-pulls 38, bath-furniture 50, bathtubs 31). (c) DISCRIMINATION: an invented group_id 'ZZZ-not-a-real-group' returns total_num_results=0, so the endpoint is not serving a default; every real group returns its own distinct number (6..387) and none equals the department total (bath = 1265). (d) PARTITION CHECK: the four recorded Bath Plumbing children sum to exactly 387, which is exactly the 'All Bath Plumbing' roll-up - independent evidence that the children are complete and that no plumbing subcategory was missed. (e) NO AGGREGATION: no parent number was reused for a child and no quantities were summed into a row.
